title:
Von der Sirenen Listigkeit
 Tun die Poeten dichten
html_source:
German for: “From the Sirens' craftiness / Poets make poems.” Jeep’s song was taken from a Renaissance Latin translation of The Odyssey. The significance for Stephen and his aspirations is obvious. Other lyrics in that first verse have more to do with Bloom’s concern of what might rob a young aspiring poet of his gifts, being lured by those sirens: "

“That they with their loveliness / Have drawn many men into the sea / For their song resounds so sweetly, / That the sailors fall asleep, The ship is brought into misfortune, / And all becomes evil.”
